_readme: Monthly Family History Challenge. Adult goals for 2027 follow the ward Temple and Family History plan. id is YYYY-MM. dateNote is shown when a gathering date is not set. Do not invent those dates. link must be an https FamilySearch, Church, or Help Gather Israel (helpgatherisrael.org) page that loads. Owned by Sister Shalisa Bingham. Do not add a phone number, email, or other member names.

kids.title: Share a Family Tradition
steps: Print “A Letter to My Future Family” or the interview booklet from Help Gather Israel, or use this month’s card.
Write or draw one tradition your family loves.
Act it out, then help an adult save it as a memory.

parents.title: Record a Family Tradition
steps: Choose one family tradition.
Record it in writing, photos, or audio.
Add it as a memory in FamilySearch.

together.title: Tradition Night
steps: Do the tradition, or act out the card.
Let a child show the drawing.
An adult or youth saves it so it is not forgotten.

kids.title: Interview a Loved One
steps: Print the Interview a Loved One booklet from Help Gather Israel, or use this month’s card.
Ask someone you love about their childhood.
Draw or write the story they tell you.

parents.title: 5th Sunday Lesson
steps: Choose one story or testimony of family history and temple work.
Practice telling it in a few minutes.
Share it when the January lesson date is set.

together.title: Practice at Home
steps: Sit together for the interview.
Let the child ask the questions first.
An adult or youth adds what the temple means to your family.

kids.title: Get Started on FamilySearch
steps: With a parent, create or sign in to a FamilySearch account. Ages 8–12 need a parent or guardian’s permission.
Open your family tree and find one name you know.
Talk about why families go to the temple, or finish this month’s treasure hunt.

parents.title: Login & Recommend Check
steps: Log in to FamilySearch.
See that you can open your family tree.
Schedule a temple recommend interview if yours needs renewing.

together.title: Log In Side by Side
steps: Hunt side by side.
Point to one family name you both know.
Say why the temple matters.

kids.title: Be a Photo Detective
steps: Look at a family photo, or try the Detective Evidence Challenge from Help Gather Israel.
Ask who is in the picture and what was happening.
Say every name while an adult uploads the photo.

parents.title: Upload a Photo
steps: Choose that one photo.
Upload 1 photo to FamilySearch.
Add the names of the people in it.

together.title: Upload It Together
steps: Look at the framed photo together.
Let the child say the names.
An adult or youth uploads it while the child watches.

kids.title: Become a Family History Detective
steps: Print the detective mission cards from Help Gather Israel.
Complete one mission: Ask, Discover, or Connect.
Write the name you found on your badge.

parents.title: Find 1 Name
steps: Open your family tree.
Add at least 1 new person.
Check the name with someone who knows the family.

together.title: Add the Name Together
steps: Search side by side.
Let the child help choose the person.
Add that one name before you stop.

kids.title: Make a Name Pocket
steps: With a parent, look at Help Gather Israel’s guide for preparing a family name.
Print the Name Pocket, color it, and write that ancestor’s first name.
Fold it so it can hold a family name card.

parents.title: Submit Names to the Temple
steps: Prepare at least 1 family name or ordinance card.
Bring it to the temple.
Tell your child the first name on the card.

together.title: Carry the Card
steps: Read the name together.
Slip a card into the pocket the child made.
Walk the temple grounds with that name if you can.

kids.title: My Family Tree Adventure
steps: Print the Family Tree Adventure from Help Gather Israel, or color this month’s Family Fan.
Fill in you, your parents, and your grandparents.
Compare the names with the first four generations in FamilySearch.

parents.title: 4 Generations Check
steps: Open your first 4 generations in FamilySearch.
Verify the names, dates, and places.
Correct them if something is wrong.

together.title: Check While You Draw
steps: Color the fan while an adult or youth checks the screen.
Compare the names you both know.
Fix one name together if it does not match.

kids.title: Build a Paper Temple
steps: Print the Temple to Color.
Color it, cut it, and fold it so it stands.
Tell what you hope to see at the open house.

parents.title: Salt Lake Temple Open House
steps: Watch for the official open house dates.
Choose one time your family can go.
Attend one open house event when it is announced.
parents.linkLabel: Open the Salt Lake Temple Page

together.title: Plan the Open House
steps: Stand the paper temple next to the temple page.
Talk about what you hope to see.
Go together when the date is shared.

kids.title: Write or Draw a Family Story
steps: Print “A Letter to My Future Family,” or use this month’s story comic.
Draw or write one family story.
Tell the story while an adult saves it on FamilySearch.

parents.title: Upload a Story or Document
steps: Choose 1 story or document.
Upload it to FamilySearch.
Attach it to the person it is about.

together.title: Save the Story Together
steps: The child tells the comic out loud.
An adult or youth types or scans it.
Upload it while you are still sitting together.

kids.title: Make a Thank-You Certificate
steps: Print the Thank-You Certificate.
Draw why you are glad that ancestor is in your family.
Sign it and give it to an adult or youth.

parents.title: Ward Temple Day
steps: Watch for the ward temple day date.
Plan to join the ward temple session.
If you cannot attend, prepare a name for someone who can.

together.title: Get Ready for Temple Day
steps: Read the certificate together.
Say the ancestor's name.
Add the ward temple day when the date is announced.

kids.title: Play Family History Bingo
steps: Print picture bingo for younger children or word bingo for older children from Help Gather Israel.
Play together and shout “FAMILY!”
Tell an adult or youth one way you helped someone get ready.

parents.title: Temple Preparation Focus
steps: Finish any ordinance cards you are still holding.
Or help a family member get ready for the temple.
Tell your child one way you helped.

together.title: Prepare Side by Side
steps: The child marks four squares.
An adult or youth finishes a card or helps someone prepare.
Give a handmade note to that person together.

kids.title: Make a Five-Name Crown
steps: With a parent, find five family names using Help Gather Israel’s five-names invitation.
Print the Five Stars and write one name on each star.
Cut them out and tape a crown or a chain.

parents.title: Submit 5 Names
steps: Find family names that are ready.
Print at least 5 ordinance cards.
Submit them to the temple.

together.title: Count the Five
steps: Count the five names out loud.
The child holds the stars.
An adult or youth submits the cards.

kids.title: Make a Tradition Recipe Page
steps: Print “A Letter to My Future Family” or this month’s recipe page.
Draw the tradition and the steps.
Do it or tell it, then help save the page as a memory.

parents.title: Record a Family Tradition
steps: Record one tradition in writing, photos, or audio.
Add it as a memory in FamilySearch.
Attach it to the family it belongs to.

together.title: Do It and Save It
steps: Do the tradition together.
Let each child add one detail on the page.
Save the memory before the night ends.
